job: BCC 4-16 Filwood Broadway (Stepnell), bid S25233B - as it stands 28/07/2026, two days before the 30/07 return
_note: Live job, not a fixture. Seven Aluprof shopfront screens, 122.98 m2 at the trade bill's nominal S.O. (ED-04 4930x3570 x4, ED-05 5550x2970 x2, ED-06 6315x3105 x1). Gintare's outgoing tender is GBP 67,067.58 ex VAT on Bellview/BSW 0000000507. A second quote, Aplus QT51510 (Technal STII, 27/07), arrived 28/07 at GBP 34,445.91 - but with 46.09 m2 of infill excluded as 'Panels by others', so it is not a like-for-like. Both suppliers have now stated in writing that they cannot meet the element U-value. Rebuild the workbook with scripts/filwood_quote_check.py.

systems_specified.fabricator: NONE APPROACHED - Aluminium Fire Systems fabricate Aluprof MB-78EI (their Q7585 to us) but have not been asked about the shopfront/CW ranges

performance.required: U 1.0 per element, g 0.5-0.6, ED-06 >= Rw 32 dB and LPS 1175 SR2
performance.evidence: SETTLED 29/07 from Aluprof's own product data: MB-SR50N HI is Uf 0.85-0.94 W/m2K, against Technal STII's stated 1.8/1.9. Uf is the frame figure not whole-element Ucw, so it is not proof the finished screen reaches 1.0 - but it puts the specified system in a different thermal class and makes the 1.0 target achievable in the specified system. Aluprof UK: living@aluprof.com, 0161 941 4005, Altrincham - the email printed in Stepnell's own trade bill. Their approved-fabricator list is behind a trade login (strefa.aluprof.com), so nobody outside can name one; ask them. NOBODY HAS PRICED IT.

systems_specified.system: SMA Shopline Double (offered as an unstated alternative)

performance.required: U 1.0 per element, g 0.5-0.6, ED-06 >= Rw 32 dB
performance.evidence: Bellview email 24/07/2026 06:43: 'we have met the u- and g- and acoustic value for glazing only, as these area commercial thermally broken shopfront products they are non rebated.' Glazing-only compliance is not element compliance. No Rw, no g-value and no coating appear anywhere on quote 0000000507.

systems_specified.system: Technal STII (offered as an unstated alternative)

performance.required: U 1.0 per element, g 0.5-0.6, ED-06 >= Rw 32 dB
performance.evidence: Aplus QT51510 p16, their own words: 'Quoted in STII, these will only reach 1.8/1.9 U Value.' Also 'STII doors have no formal acoustic test data' and 'Glass quoted has a g value of 0.66' against a 0.5-0.6 requirement. Their Terms of Sale go further: 'Commercial doors and framing will be supplied with a U-Value of up to 3.0 Wm2/K'.

rejected_elements: ED-04 x4, ED-05 x2, ED-06 - Aplus STII stated at 1.8/1.9 against a 1.0 target
ED-04 x4, ED-05 x2, ED-06 - BSW SMA Shopline compliance stated for GLAZING ONLY on non-rebated frames
u_value.note: Drawing 2411-RCK-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-31551 Rev.P02 gives 'Target U-Value' per type mark in a per-element schedule: 1.0 for ED-04 and ED-05, '1.0 for Retail Unit, N/A for Core' on ED-06. Both suppliers have quoted glass Ug (1.0 / 1.1 / 1.2) and neither has offered an element Uw. Two independent fabricators saying no is the finding: a standard commercial shopfront system does not reach 1.0, which is very likely why the architect specified Aluprof.

delivery_terms.charge_basis: Aplus Terms of Sale p18: 'All orders are priced as Ex-Works'. 'Loads over GBP 5000 + VAT will be delivered FOC within a 50-mile radius of Watford'. The GBP 1/mile each way rule is written only for loads UNDER GBP 5,000. Filwood Broadway, Bristol BS4 1JN is roughly 105 miles from Watford, so the order is over the value threshold and outside the distance one, and the quote does not say what happens there. Deliveries are on Aplus's own Cargo or Luton box vans and 'We require suitable labour at the delivery point to unload' - unloading 3.5 m screens is not a box-van job. Stillage deliveries go by independent flat-bed haulier, priced by location, plus GBP 400 per load to collect the empties.

delivery_terms.charge_basis: House note, confirmed on Georgie's 28/07: BSW quotes are EX WORKS - 'All estimates are ex works, additional delivery charges may apply'. Carriage to Bristol is ours and is not in the 46,067.59.

Also: 'Your Value Engineering Proposals are encouraged, but must be fully detailed indicating any areas of non-compliance and be accompanied by a compliant bid.'
qualification_regime.evidence: No Form of Tender or tender acceptance page was issued with this enquiry - the ITT document list contains the ITT letter alone. Submission is by email to Adam Warner, so there is no signature page that could disapply our exclusions the way John North Hall's does. The VE clause is the live one: it requires any non-compliance to be fully detailed AND a compliant bid submitted alongside - and we are offering a substituted system with neither.

exposures.item: Wind loading and structural design of 3,570 mm mullions
exposures.our_recourse: None, and it is disclaimed twice. This is the contractor's design element that triggers Stepnell's PI requirement.
